Right: The dual ending: the two should lie together.
questions.explain: The verb is dual (3rd person, optative): the two partners together.

questions.q: Built like अभिसान्त्व्य (having soothed), what does उपविश्य mean?
optionExplain: Right: Prefix + root + -य = absolutive: having done.
'To sit down' would be the infinitive उपवेष्टुम्.
That would be a present participle.
That would be the optative उपविशेत्.
questions.explain: अभि + सान्त्व् + य = having soothed; उप + विश् + य = having sat down.
questions.teaches: With a prefix, the absolutive (having done) ends in -य instead of -त्वा.

questions.q: By unit 106, with what is she sprinkled?
optionExplain: No oil is named in this unit.
Right: शीतोदकेन: with cold water.
No milk is named in this unit.
No ghee is named in this unit.
questions.explain: He should suddenly sprinkle her with cold water.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 106 in their printed order.
questions.explain: At the end, and her, with cold water, suddenly, should sprinkle.
questions.rule: पर्यन्ते → च एनाम् → शीतोदकेन → सहसा → परिषिञ्चेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 106 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: When, whom, with what, and how.
questions.teaches: एनाम् is a feminine accusative pronoun: her (the woman).

questions.q: Which split of चैनाम् is right?
optionExplain: चै is not a word; नाम् is not the pronoun.
अ + इ would give ए: चेनाम्.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ: च + एनाम् → चैनाम्.
अ + अ would give आ: चानाम्.
questions.explain: च (and) + एनाम् (her).

questions.q: By unit 106, when and how is the sprinkling done?
optionExplain: The unit says at the end (पर्यन्ते).
पर्यन्ते = at the end; सहसा = suddenly.
The month of chastity is in unit 100.
Right: पर्यन्ते … सहसा: at the end, suddenly.
questions.explain: At the end he should suddenly sprinkle her with cold water.
questions.rule: पर्यन्ते = at the end; सहसा = suddenly.

questions.q: By the rule of शीतोदकेन (शीत + उदकेन), how is गङ्गा + उदकम् written when joined?
optionExplain: Right: आ + उ → ओ, as अ + उ → ओ in शीत + उदकेन.
आ + उ gives ओ, not औ.
The आ cannot simply vanish.
The उ cannot simply vanish.
questions.explain: शीत + उदकेन → शीतोदकेन; so गङ्गा + उदकम् → गङ्गोदकम्.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before उ or ऊ merges into ओ (गुण).

questions.q: By unit 107, what happens to a woman who is hungry, frightened or angry?
options: A foetus, but always a girl
No foetus, or a defective foetus
Twins, or a child of short life
No monthly flow for a year
optionExplain: No child's sex is named in this unit.
Right: वा न गर्भ(ं) धत्ते विगुणं वा: the two stated outcomes (printed वान गर्भ).
Neither twins nor length of life is named here.
The unit says nothing of the monthly flow.
questions.explain: The list ends with two outcomes: no foetus is borne, or a defective one.
questions.rule: न गर्भं धत्ते विगुणं वा = does not bear a foetus, or bears a defective one.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 107 to its meaning.
questions.explain: All are feminine nominative singulars describing the woman.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put these states of the woman in unit 107 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Over-fed comes first, then thirsty, dejected, angry, and desiring another near the end.
questions.teaches: Unit 107 lists the states first and puts the verb धत्ते near the end with its two outcomes.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split of अत्याशिता is right?
optionExplain: अत्य is not a word; the prefix is अति.
शिता is not a word of the card.
Right: इ + आ → या: अति + आशिता = अत्याशिता.
इ + short अ would give अत्यशिता, with a short अ.
questions.explain: अति (over) + आशिता (fed): इ before आ becomes य्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which statements about unit 107 are right?
options: Grief and anger are among the listed states
A defective foetus is one stated outcome
A remedy for each state is given
The states are said of the man
optionExplain: Right: शोकार्ता and क्रुद्धा.
Right: विगुणं वा.
No remedy is given in this unit.
The adjectives are feminine: the woman is meant.
questions.explain: The unit lists the woman's states and two outcomes; it gives no remedy.
questions.rule: Feminine list + धत्ते: no foetus, or a defective one.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By the rule of अत्याशिता, how is अति + आदरः (excessive respect) written when joined?
optionExplain: The two vowels are joined, not left side by side.
The long आ of आदरः cannot turn short.
इ + आ does not give ए.
Right: इ + आ → या, as in अति + आशिता.
questions.explain: अति + आदरः = अत्यादरः, like अति + आशिता = अत्याशिता.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य् and the vowel follows: अति + आ → अत्या.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By line 2 of unit 108, what kind of child is born?
options: A male who behaves like a woman, or a female like a man
A male who behaves like a man, or a female like a woman
A weak male, or a female with defective senses
No child at all, or one of very short life
optionExplain: Right: स्त्रीचेष्टः पुमान् ... पुंचेष्टा वा स्त्री.
That reverses the text: the behaviour is crossed.
Weakness and senses are not named here.
Line 2 says a child is born (जायते).
questions.explain: Line 2: a male with a woman's behaviour, or a female with a man's behaviour.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 108 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two of these come from line 1, three from line 2.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put the words of line 2 of unit 108 in the line's order.
questions.explain: For thus, with a woman's behaviour, a male, is born, or a female with a man's behaviour.
questions.rule: तथा हि → स्त्रीचेष्टः → पुमान् → जायते → पुंचेष्टा वा स्त्री.
questions.teaches: तथा हि (for thus) gives the reason for the rule just before it.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split of पुरुषोऽपि is right?
optionExplain: उपि is not a word of the card.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and the अ of अपि is dropped, marked ऽ.
A dual पुरुषौ would join as पुरुषावपि.
पि is not a word; the dropped अ is marked by ऽ.
questions.explain: पुरुषः (man) + अपि (also): अः before अ becomes ओ and the अ is dropped.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: What does the card give for असौ in न चासावधस्तिष्ठेत्?
optionExplain: -औ here is not a dual ending; असौ is singular.
Her would be ताम् or एनाम्.
Right: The card labels असौ m. nom. sg., that (one).
The card gives no locative here.
questions.explain: असौ = that one, the man, singular; its -औ is not a dual sign.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By the rule of अधस्तिष्ठेत् (अधः + तिष्ठेत्), how is वातः + तिष्ठति written when joined?
optionExplain: ओ comes before a voiced sound; त is not voiced.
श् comes before च, छ or श, not before त.
The visarga is not simply dropped before त.
Right: Visarga before त becomes स्, as अधः + तिष्ठेत्.
questions.explain: वातः + तिष्ठति = वातस्तिष्ठति, like अधः + तिष्ठेत् = अधस्तिष्ठेत्.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त or थ becomes स्: अधः + तिष्ठेत् → अधस्तिष्ठेत्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 109, in which positions should the woman not be approached?
options: Lying face down, or lying on her side
Lying on her back, or seated upright
Standing, or lying face down only
Lying on her side, or on her back
optionExplain: Right: न्युब्जाम् and पार्श्वगताम् are both forbidden.
Lying on the back is advised in unit 113.
Standing is not named in this unit.
Lying on the back is not forbidden here.
questions.explain: Face down (न्युब्जा) and on the side (पार्श्वगता) are the two positions named.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 109 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two positions, joined by वा, are the object of सेवेत, negated by न.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put the words of unit 109 in the line's order.
questions.explain: And not, face down, on the side, or, should resort to.
questions.rule: न च → न्युब्जाम् → पार्श्वगताम् → वा → सेवेत.
questions.teaches: The verb सेवेत comes last; the negation न च stands at the head of the line.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: What form does the card give सेवेत?
options: Third singular optative: should resort to
First singular present: I resort to
Third plural optative: they should resort
optionExplain: The present would be सेवते.
Right: The card labels it 3 sg. opt. ātm.
That would be सेवे.
That would be सेवेरन्.
questions.explain: सेवेत = he should resort to: an optative of rule, here negated by न.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Why are न्युब्जाम् and पार्श्वगताम् in the accusative?
options: They describe the man, the subject of सेवेत
They name the place where union happens
They describe the woman, the object of सेवेत
They give the reason why it is forbidden
optionExplain: A subject would be nominative, not accusative.
A place would be in the locative.
Right: The card gives both as f. acc. sg., the object.
They name positions; the reasons come in units 110 to 112.
questions.explain: The woman is the object of सेवेत, so her descriptions are feminine accusatives.
questions.rule: Object of the verb → accusative: न्युब्जाम्, पार्श्वगताम्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Built like न्युब्जाम्, which form says a woman lying on her back as the object of सेवेत?
optionExplain: That is the nominative, used for a subject.
That is the locative, in her.
That is the genitive or ablative.
Right: Feminine -आ stem, accusative singular -आम्, like न्युब्जाम्.
questions.explain: उत्ताना → उत्तानाम्, as न्युब्जा → न्युब्जाम्.
questions.teaches: A feminine -आ stem makes its accusative singular in -आम्: न्युब्जा → न्युब्जाम्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 110, which doṣa is strong in a woman lying face down?
optionExplain: Right: न्युब्जायां वातो बलवान्.
Pitta is named for the left side in unit 112.
Kapha (श्लेष्मा) is named for the right side in unit 111.
The unit names Vāta as strong.
questions.explain: Face down: Vāta is strong and presses the yoni.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 110 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Position, doṣa, its strength, its target and its action.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put the words of unit 110 in the line's order.
questions.explain: In one face down, Vāta, strong; it, the yoni, presses.
questions.rule: न्युब्जायाम् → वातः → बलवान् → सः → योनिम् → पीडयति.
questions.teaches: The unit is a small chain: position, then the doṣa made strong, then what it does.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split explains वातो बलवान्?
optionExplain: A dual वातौ would stay वातौ; the card gives वातः, singular.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant (ब) becomes ओ.
An accusative would be written वातं before ब.
ओबलवान् is not a word.
questions.explain: वातः (Vāta) + बलवान् (strong): अः → ओ before the voiced ब.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: How does न्युब्जायाम् of unit 110 differ from न्युब्जाम् of unit 109?
options: It is plural, while न्युब्जाम् is singular
It is masculine, while न्युब्जाम् is feminine
It is locative, in her; न्युब्जाम् is accusative
It is a verb, while न्युब्जाम् is a noun
optionExplain: Both are singular.
Both are feminine.
Right: The card gives न्युब्जायाम् as f. loc. sg.
Neither is a verb.
questions.explain: Unit 109: the woman as object (-आम्); unit 110: in her (-आयाम्), where Vāta grows strong.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By the rule of वातो बलवान्, how is रोगः + बलवान् written when joined?
optionExplain: र् comes after vowels other than अ/आ, not after अः.
स् comes only before त or थ.
The अ does not lengthen; अः gives ओ.
Right: अः before a voiced consonant becomes ओ, as in वातो बलवान्.
questions.explain: रोगः + बलवान् = रोगो बलवान्, like वातः + बलवान् = वातो बलवान्.
questions.teaches: After अ, a visarga before a voiced consonant joins as ओ: वातः + बलवान् → वातो बलवान्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 111, what does Kapha do in a woman lying on her right side?
options: Pressed and displaced, it closes the womb
Grown strong, it presses the yoni
Grown dry, it shrinks the womb
Displaced, it pushes the foetus left
optionExplain: Right: श्लेष्मा पीडितश्च्युतोऽपिदधाति गर्भाशयम्.
That is Vāta in one lying face down, unit 110.
Dryness and shrinking are not named here.
The unit says nothing of moving a foetus.
questions.explain: Right side: Kapha, pressed and displaced, closes the womb.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 111 to its meaning.
pairs: of one lying on the right side
questions.explain: Position, doṣa, two states of the doṣa and the organ affected.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put the words of unit 111 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of one on the right side, Kapha, pressed, displaced, closes, the womb.
questions.rule: दक्षिणपार्श्वगायाः → श्लेष्मा → पीडितः → च्युतः → अपिदधाति → गर्भाशयम्.
questions.teaches: Two participles (पीडितः, च्युतः) describe Kapha before its verb अपिदधाति.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split of पीडितश्च्युतो is right?
optionExplain: An -म् ending would be written पीडितं, not पीडितश्.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्; च्युतः then becomes ओ before अ.
श्च्युतः is not a word.
A dual पीडितौ would not turn into पीडितश्.
questions.explain: पीडितः (pressed) + च्युतः (displaced): visarga → श् before च.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: In the print च्युतो ऽपिदधाति, what does the sign ऽ mark?
options: A pause at the end of the sentence
A long vowel in the following word
The अ of अपिदधाति, dropped after ओ
optionExplain: The sentence end is not marked by ऽ.
ऽ does not lengthen a vowel.
Right: च्युतः + अपिदधाति: अः + अ → ओ, and the अ drops (ऽ).
A verb ending -ति has no visarga to lose.
questions.explain: ऽ (avagraha) shows where an initial अ was dropped after ओ.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By the rule of पीडितश्च्युतः, how is वातः + च written when joined?
optionExplain: ओ comes before a voiced sound; च is not voiced.
स् comes before त or थ, not before च.
The visarga is not simply dropped before च.
Right: Visarga before च becomes श्, as in पीडितः + च्युतः.
questions.explain: वातः + च = वातश्च, like पीडितः + च्युतः = पीडितश्च्युतः.
questions.teaches: A visarga before च or छ becomes श्: पीडितः + च्युतः → पीडितश्च्युतः.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 112, which doṣa acts in a woman lying on her left side?
options: None; the left side is advised
optionExplain: Right: वामपार्श्वगायास्तद्वत्पित्तम्.
Vāta is named for lying face down, unit 110.
Kapha is named for the right side, unit 111.
The position advised is lying on the back, unit 113.
questions.explain: Left side: Pitta, acting similarly to the doṣas of units 110 and 111.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Put these words of unit 112 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Of one on the left side, similarly, Pitta, burns; the doubtful object रक्तशुके follows and is left out.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: What does तद्वत् tell the reader in unit 112?
options: Pitta acts unlike the doṣas of units 110 and 111
Pitta acts like the doṣas of units 110 and 111
Pitta comes only after twelve nights have passed
Pitta is to be removed by the same remedy
optionExplain: तद्वत् means similarly, not unlike.
Right: The data takes तद्वत् as similarly to units 110 and 111.
No time is named in this unit.
No remedy is named in this unit.
questions.explain: तद्वत् = similarly: one more position, one more doṣa, in the same pattern.
questions.teaches: तद्वत् (in that way) carries the pattern of the previous units onto a new case.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split of वामपार्श्वगायास्तद्वत् is right?
optionExplain: A locative -आम् would be written -आं before त.
स्तद्वत् is not a word.
Right: Visarga before त becomes स्.
A dative -ऐ would stay -ऐ, not turn into -आस्.
questions.explain: वामपार्श्वगायाः (of one on the left side) + तद्वत् (similarly): visarga → स् before त.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each position of units 110 to 112 to the doṣa named for it.
questions.explain: Three positions, three doṣas: face down Vāta, right side Kapha, left side Pitta.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Built like वामपार्श्वगायाः, which form of पार्श्वगता means of one lying on the side?
optionExplain: That is the accusative, as in unit 109.
That is the instrumental, by her.
That is the locative, in her.
Right: Feminine -आ stem, genitive singular -आयाः, like वामपार्श्वगायाः.
questions.explain: पार्श्वगता → पार्श्वगतायाः, as वामपार्श्वगा → वामपार्श्वगायाः.
questions.teaches: A feminine -आ stem makes its genitive singular in -आयाः: वामपार्श्वगा → वामपार्श्वगायाः.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 113, in what position should the woman receive the seed?
optionExplain: Right: उत्ताना = lying on the back, supine.
Face down is forbidden in unit 109.
The right side is linked to Kapha, unit 111.
The left side is linked to Pitta, unit 112.
questions.explain: Lying on her back (उत्ताना) she should receive the seed.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each word of unit 113 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The doubtful first word दस्मात् is left out.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Lying on her back, she should receive the seed: ____ बीजं गृह्णीयात् (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: उत्ताना = lying on her back, feminine nominative: the woman is the subject.
questions.teaches: उत्ताना (supine) is the advised position, after three forbidden ones.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which split of the printed बीजंगृह्णीयात् is right?
optionExplain: A visarga form would join as बीजो, not बीजं.
Right: म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra (ं).
अंगृह्णीयात् is not a word.
The card gives बीजम्, n. acc. sg., not बीजन्.
questions.explain: बीजम् (seed) + गृह्णीयात् (should receive): final म् → ं before ग.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Which statements about unit 113 are right?
options: The woman is the subject of गृह्णीयात्
गृह्णीयात् is an optative: should receive
The man is told to lie on his back
The seed is said to be blood
optionExplain: Right: उत्ताना is feminine nominative.
Right: the card labels it 3 sg. opt.
उत्ताना is feminine: the woman lies on her back.
बीज is glossed seed, probably semen, not blood.
questions.explain: The woman, lying on her back, should receive the seed.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By the rule of बीजं गृह्णीयात्, how is फलम् + खादेत् (should eat the fruit) written when joined?
optionExplain: ओ comes from a visarga after अ, not from म्.
That changes the word into a visarga form.
Right: म् before a consonant becomes anusvāra, as in बीजं गृह्णीयात्.
The म् does not become a long आ.
questions.explain: फलम् + खादेत् = फलं खादेत्, like बीजम् + गृह्णीयात् = बीजं गृह्णीयात्.
questions.teaches: A final म् before a consonant is written as anusvāra: बीजम् + गृह्णीयात् → बीजं गृह्णीयात्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 114, where do the doṣas remain?
optionExplain: The womb is not named in this unit.
Blood and semen are not named here.
The unit says the opposite: in their own places.
Right: यथास्थानमेव तिष्ठन्ति दोषाः.
questions.explain: The doṣas remain just in their own places.
questions.rule: यथास्थानम् एव = just in their own places.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Match each part of unit 114 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The doubtful opening तथा(इ)ह is left out.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: So here the doṣas remain in their own places: यथास्थानमेव ____ दोषाः (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तिष्ठन्ति = they remain, printed तिष्ठंति with anusvāra.
questions.teaches: तिष्ठन्ति is the present third person plural of स्था, agreeing with दोषाः.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: What does यथास्थानम् mean in unit 114?
options: In the place of the foetus
optionExplain: Right: यथा + स्थानम्: according to place, each in its own.
यथा- here means according to each one's place.
No word for away occurs.
The foetus is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: यथास्थानम् = according to place: each doṣa in its own place.
questions.rule: यथा + noun = according to that noun.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: The print reads तिष्ठंति. Which reading does the card give?
options: तिष्ठति: the anusvāra is a misprint
तिष्ठन्ति, with न् for the anusvāra
तिष्ठामि: the verb is first person
तिष्ठेत्: the verb is an optative
optionExplain: The plural subject दोषाः needs the plural तिष्ठन्ति.
Right: Before त the anusvāra is read as the nasal न्.
No first-person form is given; दोषाः needs the third person.
The card labels it present, not optative.
questions.explain: तिष्ठंति = तिष्ठन्ति, they remain; the anusvāra before त stands for न्.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: Invented line: दोषो यथास्थानमेव ____ (the doṣa remains in its place). Which verb fits?
optionExplain: That is plural, for दोषाः.
That is dual, for two subjects.
Right: A singular subject takes the singular तिष्ठति.
That is first person, I remain.
questions.explain: दोषः (one) + तिष्ठति; दोषाः (many) + तिष्ठन्ति.
questions.teaches: The verb agrees in number with its subject: दोषः तिष्ठति, दोषाः तिष्ठन्ति.
questions.section: समागम में वर्जनीय अवस्थाएँ और शयन-स्थिति

questions.q: By unit 115, in which lunar mansion should the puṃsavana be employed?
optionExplain: Rohiṇī is not named in this unit.
Maghā is not named in this unit.
Revatī is not named in this unit.
Right: पुष्ये = in Puṣya.
questions.explain: पुष्ये पुंसवनादि प्रयुञ्जीत: in Puṣya one should employ the puṃsavana and the like.
questions.rule: पुष्ये = in the lunar mansion Puṣya.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 115 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The damaged middle word is left out.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 115 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Having known her to have conceived, in Puṣya, the puṃsavana and the like, one should employ.
questions.teaches: First conception is known, then the rite is done in Puṣya: the absolutive comes before the main verb.

questions.q: Which split of चैनाम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: अ + ए → ऐ: च + एनाम् = चैनाम्.
अ + इ would give ए: चेनाम्.
चै is not a word of the card.
ऐनाम् is not a word; the pronoun is एनाम्.
questions.explain: च (and) + एनाम् (her): अ before ए becomes ऐ.

questions.q: What form is विदित्वा, and what does it show?
options: Infinitive: in order to know it
optionExplain: The optative of the line is प्रयुञ्जीत.
Right: The card labels it abs. √vid; -त्वा = having done.
A present form would end in -ति.
An infinitive would end in -तुम्.
questions.explain: विदित्वा = having known: the knowing comes before employing the rite.

questions.q: By the rule of चैनाम्, how is च + एव written when joined?
optionExplain: अ + ए gives ऐ, not ए.
The two vowels are joined, not left side by side.
Right: अ + ए → ऐ, as in च + एनाम्.
No य् comes between अ and ए.
questions.explain: च + एव = चैव, like च + एनाम् = चैनाम्.
questions.teaches: A or आ before ए or ऐ joins into ऐ: च + एनाम् → चैनाम्.

questions.q: By unit 116, what time do others give for the rite?
optionExplain: Every day is the view of unit 118.
Paired days are the view of unit 117.
Puṣya is the statement of unit 115, not of the others.
Right: द्वादशरात्रम् इति अन्ये.
questions.explain: Others say: twelve nights.
questions.rule: द्वादशरात्रम् = a period of twelve nights.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 116 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Number, period, quote-marker and the holders of the view.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 116 in the line's order.
questions.explain: The view, then इति, then who holds it.
questions.teaches: A view is quoted, closed by इति, and its holders are named after it; the verb of saying is understood.

questions.q: Which split of इत्यन्ये is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: इति + अन्ये = इत्यन्ये.
इत्य is not a word; the particle is इति.
यन्ये is not a word.
Neither इत् nor यन्ये is a word of the card.
questions.explain: इति (thus) + अन्ये (others): इ before अ becomes य्.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 116 are right?
options: The verb of saying is understood, not printed
It reports another view on the time of the rite
It says the nights are counted from conception
It names the others as Ātreya's pupils
optionExplain: Right: the line is elliptical.
Right: a further opinion on the rite of unit 115.
The starting point is not stated.
The others are not named.
questions.explain: An elliptical line: one view, one group of holders, no verb.
questions.rule: X इति अन्ये = X, so others (say).

questions.q: By the rule of इत्यन्ये, how is इति + आह (thus he said) written when joined?
optionExplain: The long आ of आह cannot turn short.
Right: इ + आ → या, as इ + अ → य in इत्यन्ये.
इ does not become ए here, and vowels are not left side by side.
The इ is not simply dropped.
questions.explain: इति + आह = इत्याह, like इति + अन्ये = इत्यन्ये.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + vowel.
questions.teaches: The final इ of इति becomes य् before a different vowel: इति + अन्ये → इत्यन्ये.

questions.q: By unit 117, on which days do some say the rite should be?
optionExplain: Every day is the view of unit 118.
Twelve nights is the view of unit 116.
Right: युग्मदिनेषु = on paired days.
Odd days are not named.
questions.explain: Some say: on the paired days.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 117 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Place-word, particle, the view and its holders.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 117 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Even in that, on paired days, so some.
questions.teaches: Same frame as unit 116: view, इति, then its holders.

questions.q: Which split of युग्मदिनेष्विति is right?
optionExplain: इ + इ would give ई: दिनेषीति.
That would join as दिनेष्वेति.
विति is not a word.
Right: उ + इ → वि: दिनेषु + इति = दिनेष्विति.
questions.explain: युग्मदिनेषु (on paired days) + इति (thus): उ before इ becomes व्.

questions.q: Which days does unit 117 say the paired days are?
options: It does not say which days are meant
The days of the new moon
The days of the Puṣya mansion
The days after the twelve nights
optionExplain: Right: The data: which days are meant is not stated.
No new moon is named.
Puṣya is named in unit 115, not here.
No such link is stated.
questions.explain: युग्म = paired, even; the unit gives no list of days.

questions.q: By the rule of दिनेष्विति, how is मधु + इति written when joined?
optionExplain: उ + इ does not give ऊ.
Right: उ + इ → वि, as in दिनेषु + इति.
उ + इ does not give ए.
No य् comes between उ and इ.
questions.explain: मधु + इति = मध्विति, like दिनेषु + इति = दिनेष्विति.
questions.rule: उ + a different vowel → व् + vowel.
questions.teaches: A final उ before a different vowel becomes व्: दिनेषु + इति → दिनेष्विति.

questions.q: By unit 118, how often do others say the rite should be?
optionExplain: Twelve nights is the view of unit 116.
Paired days are the view of unit 117.
Right: प्रत्यहम् = every day.
Puṣya is the statement of unit 115.
questions.explain: Others say: every day.

questions.q: Every day, so others: ____ इत्यपरे (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: प्रत्यहम् = every day, from प्रति + अहम्.
questions.teaches: प्रत्यहम् is an indeclinable: every day.

questions.q: What kind of word does the card call प्रत्यहम्?
options: A verb meaning he says daily
A plural noun meaning the others
optionExplain: No verb is printed in the line.
The others is अपरे.
No pronoun is in this line.
Right: The card: ind. (avyayībhāva), every day.
questions.explain: प्रति + अहम् makes the indeclinable प्रत्यहम्, every day.
questions.teaches: प्रति + a noun of time can make an indeclinable of repetition: प्रत्यहम् = every day.

questions.q: Which split of प्रत्यहम् is right?
optionExplain: Right: इ + अ → य: प्रति + अहम् = प्रत्यहम्.
प्रत्य is not a word; the prefix is प्रति.
यहम् is not a word.
Neither प्रत् nor यहम् is a word.
questions.explain: प्रति (each) + अहम् (day): इ before अ becomes य्.

questions.q: Match each holder of a view in units 116 to 118 with the time they give.
questions.explain: Three views in a row: twelve nights, paired days, every day.

questions.q: By the rule of प्रत्यहम्, how is प्रति + एकम् (each one) written when joined?
optionExplain: इ + ए does not give ए alone.
Right: इ + ए → ये, as इ + अ → य in प्रत्यहम्.
इ + ए does not give ई.
ए stays ए; it does not become ऐ.
questions.explain: प्रति + एकम् = प्रत्येकम्, like प्रति + अहम् = प्रत्यहम्.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + vowel.
questions.teaches: इ before a different vowel becomes य् and the vowel stays: प्रति + अहम् → प्रत्यहम्.

questions.q: What does unit 119 (तद्यथा) do in the text?
options: It gives the time of the rite
optionExplain: The chapter goes on after it.
Times are given in units 115 to 118.
Right: The data: it introduces the procedure of the next units.
No holder of a view is named.
questions.explain: तद्यथा = that is as follows: a lead-in to the steps.

questions.q: What does तद्यथा mean?
optionExplain: Therefore would be अतः or तस्मात्.
In that way would be तद्वत् or तथा.
That pattern is इति केचित् or इति अपरे.
Right: तत् (that) + यथा (as).
questions.explain: तद्यथा = that is as follows.

questions.q: That is as follows: तद्____ (type it in Devanagari or in English letters, e.g. dharma).
questions.explain: तद्यथा = तत् + यथा.
questions.teaches: यथा = as; with तत् it means that is as follows.

questions.q: Which split of तद्यथा is right?
optionExplain: Right: त् before the voiced य becomes द्.
There is no word तद with a final अ.
That would join as तदथा, without य.
द्यथा is not a word.
questions.explain: तत् (that) + यथा (as): त् → द् before a voiced sound.

questions.q: Which statements about unit 119 are right?
options: तत् is the neuter pronoun that
The procedure itself comes in the following units
It is a metrical verse line
It contains a verb of saying
optionExplain: Right: the card gives तत् n. nom. sg.
Right: it introduces what follows.
The unit is prose.
No verb occurs in it.
questions.explain: A two-word prose lead-in: that is as follows.
questions.rule: तद्यथा = तत् + यथा, prose, no verb.

questions.q: By the rule of तद्यथा, how is सत् + गुणः (good quality) written when joined?
optionExplain: त् is voiced to द् before a voiced consonant.
Right: त् before the voiced ग becomes द्, as in तत् + यथा.
न् comes before a nasal, not before ग.
त् does not copy the next consonant here.
questions.explain: सत् + गुणः = सद्गुणः, like तत् + यथा = तद्यथा.
questions.teaches: A final त् before a voiced sound becomes द्: तत् + यथा → तद्यथा.

questions.q: By unit 120, in what is the chosen plant pounded?
optionExplain: Water is not named in this unit.
Ghee is not named in this unit.
Right: क्षीरे अभिषुत्य: having pounded in milk.
Honey is not named in this unit.
questions.explain: क्षीरे (in milk) + अभिषुत्य (having pounded).

questions.q: Put these phrases of unit 120 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Any one, in milk, having pounded, three or four drops, in the right nostril, she should herself instil.
questions.rule: अन्यतमाम् → क्षीरे → अभिषुत्य → बिन्दून् → नासापुटे → आसिञ्चेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 120 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These five words carry the sure part of the procedure.
questions.teaches: With a prefix, 'having done' ends in -य, and in -त्य after a short root vowel: अभि + सु → अभिषुत्य.

questions.q: By unit 120, in which nostril does one desiring a daughter instil the drops?
optionExplain: दक्षिणे is the right; the daughter goes with वामे, the left.
The text names a single nostril for the daughter.
The drops are instilled (आसिञ्चेत्) into the nose.
Right: वामे तु दुहितृकामा: in the left, desiring a daughter.
questions.explain: वाम = left; the left nostril goes with दुहितृकामा.
questions.rule: वामे तु दुहितृकामा = in the left, desiring a daughter.

questions.q: Which plant name of unit 120 does the card identify with the label standard?
optionExplain: Right: Banyan shoots, Ficus benghalensis, are labelled standard.
Its identity is labelled disputed.
Vernonia cinerea is labelled probable only.
This name is left unidentified.
questions.explain: Only वटशुङ्ग (banyan shoots) carries the label standard.

questions.q: By the rule of अभिषुत्य, which form means having conquered, from वि + √जि?
optionExplain: With a prefix the -त्वा ending is not used.
Right: Prefix + short root vowel: -त्य, as अभि + सु → अभिषुत्य.
A short root vowel takes -त्य, not a lengthened vowel + -य.
That is a different form: to be conquered.
questions.explain: वि + जि + त्य = विजित्य, like अभि + सु + त्य = अभिषुत्य.
questions.rule: Prefixed root: -य; after a short root vowel: -त्य.
questions.teaches: A prefixed root makes 'having done' with -य, and with -त्य when the root ends in a short vowel.

questions.q: What does unit 121 tell her not to do?
optionExplain: The verb is निष्ठीवेत्, spit out, not swallow.
No speaking is named in this line.
Right: न ... निष्ठीवेत्: she should not spit (these) out.
No lying down is named in this line.
questions.explain: निष्ठीवेत् = should spit out; न makes it a prohibition.
questions.rule: न + निष्ठीवेत् = should not spit out.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 121 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Not, and, these, should spit out.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 121 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four words make the whole line.
questions.teaches: न with an optative (-एत्) gives a prohibition: should not.

questions.q: Which split of चैतान् is right?
optionExplain: अ + इ would give ए (चेतान्), not ऐ.
चै is not a word of the card.
आन् is not a word, and त् before a vowel would become द् (चेदान्).
Right: अ + ए → ऐ: च + एतान् = चैतान्.
questions.explain: च (and) + एतान् (these): अ + ए joins as ऐ.

questions.q: एतान् is masculine accusative plural. What does it most likely refer to, by the card?
optionExplain: Right: बिन्दून् is also masculine accusative plural.
क्षीर is neuter singular.
ओषधी is feminine and comes later.
वृद्धस्त्रियः is feminine and comes later.
questions.explain: एतान् matches बिन्दून् in gender, case and number.
questions.rule: एतान् (m. acc. pl.) ↔ बिन्दून् (m. acc. pl.).

questions.q: Built like न ... निष्ठीवेत्, what does the invented line न पिबेत् mean?
optionExplain: That present would be न पिबति.
Right: न + optative = should not.
That past would be न अपिबत्.
न negates the verb.
questions.explain: पिबेत् = should drink; with न, should not drink.
questions.teaches: An optative verb (-एत्) with न forbids: न निष्ठीवेत् = should not spit out.

questions.q: By unit 122, which part of the white bṛhatī is used?
optionExplain: No leaf is named in this unit.
No flower is named in this unit.
Right: मूलकल्कात्: from the root-paste.
No fruit is named in this unit.
questions.explain: मूल = root; its paste (कल्क) gives the juice.

questions.q: Put the words of unit 122 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, uprooted under Puṣya, of white bṛhatī, from the root-paste, the juice, should instil into the nose.
questions.rule: तथा → पुष्योद्धृतायाः → श्वेतबृहत्याः → मूलकल्कात् → रसम् → नावयेत्.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 122 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Five words give the whole procedure.
questions.teaches: -आत् on an a-stem is the ablative, from: मूलकल्कात् = from the root-paste.

questions.q: Which split of पुष्योद्धृतायाः is right?
optionExplain: Neither part is a word of the card.
The ओ is the joined sound, not part of the second word.
There is no such split in the card.
Right: अ + उ → ओ: पुष्य + उद्धृता = पुष्योद्धृता.
questions.explain: पुष्य (the lunar mansion) + उद्धृता (uprooted): अ + उ joins as ओ.

questions.q: How does the card label the identity of श्वेत बृहती, white bṛhatī?
optionExplain: Right: The white form of a Solanum is labelled disputed.
That is the banyan of unit 120.
That is sahadevā of unit 120.
The card does name the genus Solanum.
questions.explain: White bṛhatī: a white form of a Solanum, identity disputed.

questions.q: Built like मूलकल्कात् रसम्, what does the invented phrase पुष्पात् रसम् mean?
optionExplain: For would be the dative पुष्पाय.
Right: -आत् is the ablative, from.
In would be the locative पुष्पे.
With would be the instrumental पुष्पेण.
questions.explain: पुष्पात् = from the flower, like मूलकल्कात् = from the root-paste.
questions.teaches: An a-stem in -आत् is ablative: from. मूलकल्कात् रसम् = juice from the root-paste.

questions.q: By unit 123, which part of lakṣmaṇā is named?
optionExplain: The leaves named are of utpala and kumuda.
The shoots named are of the banyan.
Right: लक्ष्मणामूलम्: the root of lakṣmaṇā.
No flower of lakṣmaṇā is named.
questions.explain: लक्ष्मणा + मूल = the root of lakṣmaṇā.

questions.q: Put the four plant items of unit 123 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Utpala leaf, kumuda leaf, lakṣmaṇā root, banyan shoots.

questions.q: Match each item of unit 123 to its meaning on the card.
questions.explain: The two lilies are probable identifications only.
questions.teaches: पत्र = leaf; for lotus plants it can also mean petal.

questions.q: What does unit 123 state about how these items are prepared?
options: A root-paste is made and juiced
optionExplain: Pounding in milk is in unit 120.
Paste and juice are in unit 122.
No ghee is named in this unit.
Right: The unit gives only the items and नावयेत्.
questions.explain: The unit is elliptical: items, then 'should instil into the nose'.
questions.rule: No preparation is stated in unit 123.

questions.q: Which items does unit 123 name?
optionExplain: Right: उत्पलपत्रम्.
Right: लक्ष्मणामूलम्.
Right: वटशुङ्गानि.
That is unit 122.
That is named in unit 125.
questions.explain: utpala leaf, kumuda leaf, lakṣmaṇā root and banyan shoots are named.

questions.q: A final त् before च becomes च्. How is यत् + च written?
optionExplain: Right: त् before च becomes च्: यत् + च = यच्च.
त् turns to द् before voiced sounds; च is not voiced.
No nasal comes in before च.
त् does not stay unchanged before च.
questions.explain: यत् + च = यच्च; त् + च → च्च.
questions.teaches: A final त् before च becomes च्: यत् + च → यच्च, तत् + च → तच्च.

questions.q: By unit 124, what does the woman wear?
optionExplain: The colour named is शुक्ल, white.
Right: शुक्ल-माल्य-अम्बर-धरा: wearing white garlands and garments.
The colour named is शुक्ल, white.
No such garland is named.
questions.explain: शुक्ल = white; माल्य = garland; अम्बर = garment; धरा = wearing.
questions.rule: शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरा = wearing white garlands and garments.

questions.q: Put these words of unit 124 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Wearing white, of lakṣmaṇā, root-paste, udumbara-measure, should drink, for stability.
questions.rule: वस्त्र → द्रव्य → रूप → मात्रा → क्रिया → उद्देश्य.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 124 to its meaning.
pairs: of the measure of an udumbara
questions.explain: Two datives give the two purposes.
questions.teaches: A dative can give the purpose: उत्पादाय = for the birth, स्थितये = for the stability.

questions.q: What does the card say उदुम्बरमात्र means?
options: Mixed with juice of the udumbara
Taken while sitting under an udumbara
One fixed weight stated in the text
optionExplain: No udumbara juice is named.
The word gives a measure, not a place.
Right: मात्र = measure; the text gives no weight.
No weight is stated; only the measure of an udumbara.
questions.explain: उदुम्बरमात्रम् = of the measure of an udumbara (cluster fig).
questions.rule: -मात्र after a thing = as much as that thing.

questions.q: For which purposes does unit 124 say she drinks it?
options: For the birth of a son
For the stability of the son
For the birth of a daughter
optionExplain: Right: पुत्रस्य उत्पादाय.
Right: स्थितये.
The text says पुत्रस्य, of a son.
No illness is named here.
questions.explain: Two datives: उत्पादाय (birth) and स्थितये (stability), both of a son.

questions.q: Built like उत्पादाय, which invented form says for health, from आरोग्य (neuter a-stem)?
optionExplain: That is the genitive: of health.
That is the instrumental: by health.
That is the locative: in health.
Right: a-stem dative: -आय, like उत्पादाय.
questions.explain: आरोग्य + -आय = आरोग्याय, for health.
questions.teaches: The dative of an a-stem ends in -आय and can state a purpose: उत्पादाय = for the birth.

questions.q: Which identification does the card give apāmārga, with the label standard?
optionExplain: Right: apāmārga = Achyranthes aspera (prickly chaff-flower), standard.
That is udumbara of unit 124.
That is sahadevā of unit 120.
That is the banyan (वट).
questions.explain: अपामार्ग = Achyranthes aspera (standard; Hindi चिचड़ा).

questions.q: Put these sure items of unit 125 in the list's order.
questions.explain: Apāmārga, jīvaka and ṛṣabhaka, śaṅkhapuṣpī, sahacara, and last the banyan shoots.

questions.q: Match each drug of unit 125 to the card's identification and label.
questions.explain: Each identification keeps its own label of certainty.
questions.rule: standard, probable, disputed: as the card gives them.
questions.teaches: A plant name keeps the certainty the data gives it: standard, probable, disputed or unidentified.

questions.q: What does the card do with वौरदण्ड and नम्रजीव?
options: Reads them as one word for apāmārga
optionExplain: No such identification is given.
Right: Both are unclear in print; neither is split or identified.
That probable name belongs to अग्निजिह्वा.
apāmārga is a separate, clear word.
questions.explain: Two words of the list stay unclear; nothing is built on them.

questions.q: Why does जीवक-ऋषभकौ end in -औ, by the card?
options: It names one drug with two parts
It is a locative: in jīvaka
It joins two drug names: a dual
It is a plural of three or more
optionExplain: The card names two drugs, jīvaka and ṛṣabhaka.
The card labels it accusative dual.
Right: Labelled dvandva, masculine accusative dual.
The plural would end in -आन्.
questions.explain: जीवक + ऋषभक, two names, joined as a dual compound.
questions.rule: Two a-stem names in a dvandva: -औ (dual).

questions.q: Like जीवक-ऋषभकौ, which invented compound means Rāma and Kṛṣṇa, the two of them?
optionExplain: That singular names one person.
That plural means three or more.
That is an accusative singular.
Right: Two names in a dvandva take the dual -औ.
questions.explain: Two masculine a-stem names joined: रामकृष्णौ.
questions.teaches: Two names joined as 'X and Y' (dvandva) take the dual: जीवक + ऋषभक → जीवक-ऋषभकौ.

questions.q: By unit 126, where is the woman standing when the juice is instilled?
optionExplain: Right: देहल्यां स्थिताम्: standing on the threshold.
No fire place is named for her.
Bathing is not named in this unit.
No tree is named as a place.
questions.explain: देहली = threshold; स्थिता = standing.
questions.rule: देहल्यां स्थिताम् = standing on the threshold.

questions.q: Put these steps of unit 126 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Ground, being cooked, its vapour smelled, its juice, instilled as before.
questions.rule: पीसना → पकना → भाप सूँघना → रस → नस्य.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 126 to its meaning.
questions.explain: These five words carry the procedure and the place.
questions.teaches: The passive stem in -य plus -मान gives a present passive participle: पच् + य + मान = पच्यमान, being cooked.

questions.q: By the card, who smells the vapour in unit 126?
optionExplain: No husband is named in this unit.
Right: The subject of आघ्राय is not stated.
No physician is named in this unit.
Brāhmaṇas are named in unit 127, not here.
questions.explain: The card leaves the smeller open: the woman or the person instilling.

questions.q: Which split of पूर्ववन्नावयेत् is right?
optionExplain: पूर्ववन् is not a word; it is पूर्ववत्.
The verb is नावयेत्, with न.
Right: त् before the nasal न is written न्: पूर्ववन्नावयेत्.
वन्नावयेत् is not a word.
questions.explain: पूर्ववत् (as before) + नावयेत् (should instil into the nose).
questions.rule: त् before न here shows as न्.

questions.q: Built like पूर्ववत् (as before), what does the invented line मातृवत् रक्षेत् mean?
options: One should protect for the mother
One should protect like a mother
optionExplain: That would be मातरं रक्षेत्.
That would use the dative मात्रे.
रक्षेत् is an optative, should.
Right: -वत् = like.
questions.explain: मातृवत् = like a mother, as पूर्ववत् = as before.
questions.rule: -वत् added to a word = like it.
questions.teaches: The indeclinable -वत् means 'like': पूर्ववत् = as before, मातृवत् = like a mother.

questions.q: By unit 127, whose further advice should also be followed?
optionExplain: Right: ब्राह्मणाः वृद्धस्त्रियः वा.
No king is named.
No physician is named here.
No such person is named.
questions.explain: ब्राह्मणाः (brāhmaṇas) or वृद्धस्त्रियः (old women).

questions.q: Put these parts of unit 127 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Whatever else also, brāhmaṇas, old women, that too she should do.

questions.q: Match each word of unit 127 to its meaning.
questions.explain: यत् is picked up by तत् (that) before the verb.
questions.teaches: यत् ... तत् is a pair: whatever ..., that.

questions.q: Which split of यच्चान्यदपि is right?
optionExplain: चान्यत् is not a word.
Right: त् + च → च्च; अ + अ → आ; त् → द् before अ.
चान् and यदपि are not words here.
दपि is not a word.
questions.explain: यत् (what) + च (and) + अन्यत् (else) + अपि (also).
questions.rule: त् + च → च्च; अ + अ → आ; त् + vowel → द्.

questions.q: What does unit 127 say about the content of their advice?
options: It must be a diet rule
optionExplain: No mantra is named here.
No diet is named here.
Right: The card adds nothing about what they may say.
Nothing of the kind is said.
questions.explain: Whatever they say is to be done; its content is not given.

questions.q: Built like unit 127, what does the invented line यद् गुरुर्वदेत् तत् कुर्यात् mean?
options: The teacher should do whatever the pupil may say
Whatever the teacher said, one did that
One should speak before the teacher acts
Whatever the teacher may say, one should do that
optionExplain: गुरुः is the subject of वदेत्, the one who says.
वदेत् and कुर्यात् are optatives, not past.
The teacher is the speaker here.
Right: यत् ... तत्: whatever ..., that.
questions.explain: यद् ... तत्: whatever the teacher may say, that one should do.
questions.teaches: A clause with यत् (whatever) is picked up by तत् (that): यत् ... ब्रूयुः, तत् च कुर्यात्.

questions.q: By unit 128, with what should she bear the great herbs?
options: With the head and right hand
With the left hand and the neck
optionExplain: Right: शिरसा दक्षिणेन च पाणिना.
The hand named is the right (दक्षिण).
No waist is named.
The head and the right hand are named.
questions.explain: शिरसा (with the head) and दक्षिणेन पाणिना (with the right hand).
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Put these words of unit 128 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Then, the great herbs, with the head, with the right hand, she should bear.
questions.rule: ततः → महौषधीः → शिरसा → दक्षिणेन पाणिना → धारयेत.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 128 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two instrumentals tell how the herbs are borne.
questions.teaches: The instrumental gives the means, with: शिरसा = with the head, पाणिना = with the hand.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Does unit 128 list the herbs of the prajāsthāpana group?
options: No; it names only the group
Yes; the banyan shoots are listed
optionExplain: Ten is Caraka's group, not listed in this text.
Right: The members are not listed here.
No member is listed.
No member is listed.
questions.explain: The unit gives the group's name, not its members.
questions.rule: प्रजास्थापन = a named group; members not listed here.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which split of महौषधीः is right?
optionExplain: आ + उ would give ओ, not औ.
Neither part is a word of the card.
Right: आ + ओ → औ: महा + ओषधीः = महौषधीः.
Neither part is a word of the card.
questions.explain: महा (great) + ओषधीः (herbs): आ + ओ joins as औ.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By the rule of महौषधीः, how is महा + ओजः written when joined?
optionExplain: आ + ओ gives औ, not ओ.
The two vowels are joined.
No व comes in here.
Right: आ + ओ → औ.
questions.explain: महा + ओजः = महौजः, like महा + ओषधीः = महौषधीः.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before ओ joins into औ: महा + ओषधीः → महौषधीः.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By unit 129, when should she bathe with these herbs?
optionExplain: Right: पुष्ये पुष्ये स्नायात्.
No full moon is named.
No morning is named.
No fourth night is named here.
questions.explain: पुष्ये पुष्ये = on each Puṣya (the lunar mansion).
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Put the three actions of unit 129 in the text's order.
questions.explain: Drink, then bathe, then touch.

questions.explain: The words of the drinking and the bathing.

questions.teaches: A doubled word means each one: पुष्ये पुष्ये = on every Puṣya.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: एताभिः is feminine instrumental plural. To what does it refer, by the card?
optionExplain: बिन्दु is masculine.
Right: ओषधी is feminine: the herbs of unit 128.
ब्राह्मण is masculine.
शुङ्ग here is neuter.
questions.explain: एताभिः agrees with the feminine ओषधीः of unit 128.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which split of चेत्थम् is right?
optionExplain: एत्थम् is not a word; अ + ए would give ऐ.
Neither part is a word.

थम् is not a word.
questions.explain: च (and) + इत्थम् (thus): अ + इ joins as ए.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Built like पुष्ये पुष्ये, what does the invented phrase दिने दिने mean?
optionExplain: Doubling here does not mean two.
No word for before is present.
Doubling means each, not one.
Right: A doubled word means each one.
questions.explain: दिने दिने = day by day, like पुष्ये पुष्ये = on every Puṣya.
questions.teaches: Repeating a word gives 'each, every': पुष्ये पुष्ये, दिने दिने.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By unit 130, which herbs are to be used constantly?
optionExplain: Right: सर्वासां जीवनीयानाम् ओषधीनाम्.
The unit says all the jīvanīya herbs.
The unit says all the jīvanīya herbs.
The unit says all the jīvanīya herbs.
questions.explain: सर्व (all) + जीवनीय (life-promoting) + ओषधी (herb).
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Put the words of unit 130 in the line's order.
questions.explain: Likewise, of all, of the life-promoting, herbs, constant use, by those various methods.
questions.rule: तथा → सर्वासाम् → जीवनीयानाम् → ओषधीनाम् → सदोपयोगः → तैस्तैर्विधिभिः.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 130 to its meaning.
questions.explain: The unit is a noun phrase; no verb is stated.
questions.teaches: A repeated pronoun means 'various': तैस्तैः विधिभिः = by those various methods.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which of these does unit 130 lack, by the card?
options: The name of the herb group
optionExplain: उपयोगः (use) is present.
Right: No verb is stated in unit 130.
जीवनीय is named.
सदा is present.
questions.explain: The unit is a noun phrase: use, of all jīvanīya herbs, by those methods; no verb.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which split of सदोपयोगः is right?
optionExplain: ओपयोगः is not a word; the noun is उपयोगः.
Neither part is a word of the card.
Right: आ + उ → ओ: सदा + उपयोगः = सदोपयोगः.
सदोप is not a word.
questions.explain: सदा (always) + उपयोगः (use): आ + उ joins as ओ.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By the rule of तैः + तैः → तैस्तैः, how is रामः + तत्र written?
optionExplain: ओ comes before voiced sounds; त is not voiced.
र् does not come from this visarga before त.
Visarga does not become त्.
Right: Visarga before त becomes स्.
questions.explain: रामः + तत्र = रामस्तत्र, as तैः + तैः = तैस्तैः.
questions.teaches: A visarga before त becomes स्: तैः + तैः → तैस्तैः.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: What does गर्भस्थापनानि mean, by the card?
optionExplain: Right: गर्भ = foetus; स्थापन = establishing.
स्थापन means establishing, not destroying.
No word for hastening is present.
No word for cleansing is present.
questions.explain: गर्भस्थापन = what makes the foetus stable.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Match each part of गर्भस्थापनानि to its meaning.
questions.explain: Two members and a neuter plural ending.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: What grammar does the card give गर्भस्थापनानि?
optionExplain: That would end in -आन्.
Right: -आनि marks the neuter plural.
That would end in -आः.
That would end in -अम्.
questions.explain: गर्भस्थापनानि: n. nom. pl., with no noun stated.
questions.teaches: An a-stem neuter makes its nominative plural in -आनि.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which statements about unit 131 are right?
options: No noun is stated for गर्भस्थापनानि
optionExplain: Right: no verb is stated.
Right: hence '(ones)'.
No herb is named in this unit.
It is prose.
questions.explain: A short closing phrase: no verb and no stated noun.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: In गर्भस्थापनानि, what is said to be established?
optionExplain: No herbs are named in this unit.
No husband is named in this unit.
Right: गर्भ = foetus; स्थापन = establishing.
No milk is named in this unit.
questions.explain: गर्भ + स्थापन: establishing the foetus.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Like गर्भस्थापनानि, what is the nominative plural of the neuter a-stem मूल (root)?
optionExplain: That is the masculine plural ending.
That is the singular.
That is the masculine accusative plural ending.
Right: Neuter a-stem: -आनि.
questions.explain: मूल → मूलानि, like स्थापन → स्थापनानि.
questions.teaches: A neuter a-stem takes -आनि in the nominative plural: स्थापनानि, मूलानि.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Besides the attendants, who is named in unit 132?
optionExplain: Right: तथा भर्ता: and likewise the husband.
No physician is named.

questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Put the four qualities of the attendants in the compound's order.
questions.explain: Gentle in form, speech, service and conduct.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Match each word of unit 132 to its meaning.
questions.explain: Four qualities of the attendants and the attendants themselves.

questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which split of तथाभर्तेति is right?

questions.explain: तथा (likewise) + भर्ता (husband) + इति (thus).
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By the rule of भर्ता + इति, how is सीता + इति written?
optionExplain: That would be आ + ए.
The आ cannot simply vanish.

Right: आ + इ → ए.
questions.explain: सीता + इति = सीतेति, like भर्ता + इति = भर्तेति.
questions.teaches: अ or आ before इ joins into ए: भर्ता + इति → भर्तेति.
questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: Which split of पुनश्चैनाम् is right?

questions.q: By the rule of पुनः + च → पुनश्च, how is रामः + च written?

questions.section: प्रजास्थापन औषधियाँ और गर्भिणी की सेवा

questions.q: By the rule of मध्वाभे, how is साधु + आचारः (good conduct) written as one compound?

questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which split of उदकविहाराच्च is right?

A final म् would give उदकविहारं च.
च्च is not a word; the particle is च.
questions.explain: उदकविहारात् (from sport in water) + च (and): त् + च → च्च.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By unit 135, what goes with the use of mixed (व्यामिश्र) ones?

The line names a colour for the mixed ones.

questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of मातुरुदक, how is गुरुः + आगच्छति (the teacher comes) written?
optionExplain: The visarga is dropped like this only after अ or आ.
उ turns into व् only when no visarga follows it.

The visarga does not become स् before a vowel.

questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

That is देश.
That is वर्ण.
That is भेद.

questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which split of अनुवृत्तितश्च is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give अनुवृत्तितं च.
Right: A visarga before च becomes श्: अनुवृत्तितः + च → अनुवृत्तितश्च.
श्च is not a word; the particle is च.

questions.explain: अनुवृत्तितः (by conformity) + च (and).
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of अनुवृत्तितश्च, how is रामः + च (and Rāma) written?
optionExplain: अः → ओ happens before a voiced sound; च is not voiced.
That is the rule for a final त्, not a visarga.

questions.q: By the rule of चात्र, how is न + अत्र (not here) written when joined?

questions.explain: धर्म + रता = धर्मरता, like ...आदि + रता.
questions.teaches: रत (devoted) takes the feminine -आ for a woman: X-रता = she who is devoted to X.

questions.q: By unit 145, who too discharge śukra at union?
optionExplain: Right: योषितोऽपि स्रवन्त्येव शुक्रम्.
अपि (too) adds women to men.
Pregnancy is not named in line 1.
Children are not named.

questions.q: Put these words of line 1 of unit 145 in the verse's order.

questions.q: A translation reads: 'Women too discharge śukra at union with a child.' Which word is wrong?
optionExplain: योषितः = women: right.
अपि = too: right.
Right: पुंसः means of a man, not of a child.

questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of स्रवन्त्येव, how is अस्ति + एव (is indeed) written when joined?
optionExplain: इ + ए does not give a plain ए.
इ + ए does not give ऐ.
That is अस्ति + इव, not अस्ति + एव.
Right: इ before ए becomes य्, as स्रवन्ति + एव → स्रवन्त्येव.
questions.explain: अस्ति + एव = अस्त्येव, like स्रवन्ति + एव.
questions.rule: इ + a different vowel → य् + that vowel.
questions.teaches: A final इ before a different vowel becomes य्: स्रवन्ति + एव → स्रवन्त्येव.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: Which split of प्रथमोऽध्यायः is right?
optionExplain: आ + अ would give प्रथमाध्यायः.
Right: अः + अ → ओ, and ऽ marks the lost अ.
ध्यायः is not a word; the noun is अध्यायः.
A final म् would give प्रथममध्यायः.
questions.explain: प्रथमः (first) + अध्यायः (chapter).

questions.q: Which split of पुत्रकामीयोनाम is right?
optionExplain: A final म् would give पुत्रकामीयं नाम.
योनाम is not a word.
Right: अः before the voiced न becomes ओ.
उनाम is not a word.
questions.explain: पुत्रकामीयः + नाम: अः → ओ before a voiced consonant.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार

questions.q: By the rule of प्रथमोऽध्यायः, how is द्वितीयः + अध्यायः (second chapter) written?
optionExplain: That joins a plain अ, not अः.
Visarga drops this way only before vowels other than अ.
अः does not become र् here.
Right: अः + अ → ओ with ऽ, as in प्रथमः + अध्यायः.
questions.explain: द्वितीयः + अध्यायः = द्वितीयोऽध्यायः.
questions.teaches: A final अः before अ becomes ओ, and the अ is shown by ऽ: प्रथमः + अध्यायः → प्रथमोऽध्यायः.
questions.section: संतान का वर्ण, सत्त्व और उपसंहार
